article.headline: Burton, Lindsay pace Indiana in 91-57 win over Eastern Illinois
article.description: — Transfer Markus Burton scored 19 points and reserve transfer Bryce Lindsay scored 14 points as Indiana beat Eastern Illinois 91-57 on Monday night in a season opener for both teams.
article.linkText: Burton, Lindsay pace Indiana in 91-57 win over Eastern Illinois
article.story: BLOOMINGTON, Ind. -- — Transfer Markus Burton scored 19 points and reserve transfer Bryce Lindsay scored 14 points as Indiana beat Eastern Illinois 91-57 on Monday night in a season opener for both teams. Burton, a transfer from Notre Dame, finished 7-of-8 shooting, including 3-for-3 from 3-point range. Lindsay, who has played at Texas A&M, James Madison and Villanova, made 3-of-5 shooting from 3. Indiana used a 13-for-16 effort from the free-throw line before the break to build a 44-23 halftime lead. Eight Hoosiers entered the scoring column by the break. Demar Burton led the Panthers with 10 points. Indiana enters the 2026-27 campaign with a rebuilt roster that includes eight transfers and four true freshmen. The Hoosiers are 53-3 in home season openers since Simon Skjodt Assembly Hall opened for the 1971-72 season. It has won eight straight home openers. Up next Eastern Illinois: Heads to Iowa City, Iowa, to take on the Hawkeyes on Friday. Indiana: Hosts Bellarmine on Thursday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
